import numpy as np


def forecast(train_series, history_windows, feature_cols, target_col, input_len, output_len):
    w_idx = feature_cols.index("Wspd")
    p_idx = feature_cols.index(target_col)
    # Simple power curve: map binned wind speed to mean power
    bins = np.linspace(0, 25, 26)
    bin_indices = np.digitize(train_series["Wspd"], bins)
    curve = train_series.groupby(bin_indices)[target_col].mean()

    avg_w = np.mean(history_windows[:, -6:, w_idx], axis=1)

    recent_dev = np.mean(history_windows[:, -12:, p_idx] - curve_map[np.digitize(recent_w, bins)], axis=1)
    
    decay = np.power(0.96, np.arange(output_len))
    preds = base[:, None] + (recent_dev[:, None] * decay[None, :])
    return np.clip(preds, 0.0, 5000.0)
